how_to_apply: Fill in the application form given as Annexure-1 of the notice.
Attach self-attested copies of all listed certificates, 2 signed passport-size photos and a self-addressed envelope with Rs. 5 postage stamp.
Put the application in an envelope marked 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASHA FOR ... VILLAGE/SERVICE AREA UNDER ... HEALTH SUB-CENTRE'.
Send it only by Speed Post or Registered Post to The Block Development Officer, Basanti Development Block, Sonakhali, PIN 743312.
Application must be submitted at the BDO office by 15-12-2026, 5 PM.
important_instructions: Only one application per candidate; multiple applications are all cancelled No later request or appeal is accepted about rejected applications Photo on the form must be pasted with glue, not pinned, stapled or stitched Voter list details in the form are as per the list of 09/04/2026

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Must have appeared in Madhyamik or equivalent examination; Candidates who failed Madhyamik or equivalent are also considered; Higher qualified candidates may apply, but only Madhyamik or equivalent marks are considered, with no extra advantage Age limit: Between 30 and 40 years for general candidates; between 22 and 40 years for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates (as on 25 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026 Other conditions: Only married, widowed or women divorced by court decree can apply Must be a permanent resident of the specifically identified service area of the concerned village Residence proof: self-attested copies of voter ID card and ration card Desirable: Preference to Grade-1 and Grade-2 Self-Help Group members, trained Dai and Link Workers who submit the departmental certificate Preference to SC/ST applicants in SC/ST-majority villages marked in Annexure-2

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Basanti Development Block Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A candidate submitting more than one application: all her applications are cancelled Applications without any of the listed certificates are cancelled Incomplete and erroneous applications are rejected directly

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application (up to 5 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will Basanti Development Block Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview of eligible candidates (date, time and place informed by postal letter) Only marks obtained in Madhyamik or equivalent examination are considered; higher qualification gives no extra advantage Eligible candidates receive a postal letter with interview date, time and place Originals of documents (a) to (f) must be shown on the interview day In SC/ST-majority villages, SC/ST applicants get preference; general candidates may be selected if none is found

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Birth certificate or Madhyamik/equivalent admit card Voter ID (EPIC) and ration card as resident of the area Caste certificate (SC/ST) from competent authority, if applicable Madhyamik or equivalent marksheet Marital status certificate; SHG/trained Dai/Link Worker certificate if applicable 2 signed passport-size photos, Rs. 5 stamped self-addressed envelope, voter list part and serial number copy

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Basanti Development Block Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given as Annexure-1 of the notice. Attach self-attested copies of all listed certificates, 2 signed passport-size photos and a self-addressed envelope with Rs. 5 postage stamp. Put the application in an envelope marked 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASHA FOR ... VILLAGE/SERVICE AREA UNDER ... HEALTH SUB-CENTRE'. Send it only by Speed Post or Registered Post to The Block Development Officer, Basanti Development Block, Sonakhali, PIN 743312. Application must be submitted at the BDO office by 15-12-2026, 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only one application per candidate; multiple applications are all cancelled No later request or appeal is accepted about rejected applications Photo on the form must be pasted with glue, not pinned, stapled or stitched Voter list details in the form are as per the list of 09/04/2026

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Basanti Development Block Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Basanti Development Block Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies for ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Basanti Development Block Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-1 of the notice) and send it to The Block Development Officer, Basanti Development Block, Village: Sonakhali, P.O.: Sonakhali, P.S.: Basanti, Dist.: South 24 Parganas, PIN: 743312, by speed post or registered post only, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 30 and 40 years for general candidates; between 22 and 40 years for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates (as on 25 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium based.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have appeared in Madhyamik or equivalent examination (candidates who failed are also considered). Higher qualified candidates may apply, but only Madhyamik or equivalent marks are considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only married, widowed or women divorced by court decree can apply. Must be a permanent resident of the specifically identified service area of the concerned village. Residence proof: self-attested copies of voter ID card and ration card.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A candidate submitting more than one application: all her applications are cancelled. Applications without any of the listed certificates are cancelled. Incomplete and erroneous applications are rejected directly.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview of eligible candidates (date, time and place informed by postal letter). Only marks obtained in Madhyamik or equivalent examination are considered; higher qualification gives no extra advantage. Eligible candidates receive a postal letter with interview date, time and place. Originals of documents (a) to (f) must be shown on the interview day.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract-based (chukti bhittik) engagement.
